blocks.text: A breach of over 5,000 petabytes is roughly equivalent to 5 million terabytes of data. This is how much 5G mobile data is being used as of the first nine months of 2026.
Smart advances AI-powered mobile experiences with 5G

Mobile services provider Smart Communications, Inc. (Smart), the wireless arm of PLDT Inc., is accelerating its 5G network expansion and advancing network-based innovations to meet growing mobile data demand and deliver better digital experiences to subscribers. As of September 2026, Smart had deployed 6,100 5G base stations nationwide, up from 5,400 in 2025. The number of individual 5G devices on its network reached 12.9 million, compared with 10.5 million a year earlier, reflecting the continued adoption of 5G-capable devices among subscribers.Smart’s 5G network covers 99% of the population across Metro Manila and Rizal, while its combined 5G and 4G network reaches 97% of the Philippine population. Mobile data traffic also continued to rise, reaching 5,029 petabytes in the first nine months of 2026, up from 4,393 petabytes during the same period in 2025. The growth underscores the increasing role of mobile connectivity in everyday activities, from video streaming and gaming to online learning, remote work, and the use of AI-powered applications.
Turning network investments into better digital experiences

Smart’s accelerated 5G expansion is complemented by efforts to improve network performance and develop services that help subscribers make more of their connectivity. In the first half of 2026, Smart earned Ookla’s Best Mobile Video Experience award in the Philippines for the second consecutive year, recognizing its performance in delivering mobile video experiences.In October, Smart introduced AI.Smart, a one-stop platform that brings together multiple AI tools, including AWS Nova, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, and Thinking Machines, in a user-friendly interface. The platform gives users access to AI-powered capabilities for writing, research, presentations, image generation, and data analysis.

In early November, Smart began rolling out PureVoice, Asia-Pacific’s first commercially launched native AI voice enhancement service built on the telecommunications core network. Designed to improve call clarity by filtering background noise at the network level, PureVoice does not require users to upgrade their devices or download a separate application. The service has already earned international recognition, winning Best 5G-A Service Innovation at the Global Core Summit Awards in Bangkok, Thailand.

Smart also offers subscribers ways to maximize its 5G network through its Unli 5G promos. For just P90, Smart Prepaid users can enjoy three days of unlimited 5G data plus non-stop 4G data, helping them stay connected as they stream, create content, browse, and pursue their interests. Smart will also bring its S-Tier 5G experience closer to subscribers through an on-ground activation at the Market! Market! Activity Center on December 19 to 20, 2026. The event will feature lifestyle and hobby partners, giving visitors opportunities to explore their interests and discover new experiences powered by Smart.
